title: Completed-module and strict-reduction reindexing under scheme isomorphisms
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, $A=\mathcal O_E$, $I=(\varpi_E)$ and $P_n=A/I^n$ for $n\geq1$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For a scheme $T$ on which $\ell$ is invertible put $A_T=\varprojlim_n(P_n)_T$, using the small pro-etale sites, completed-ring module categories and strict tower categories $\operatorname{Tow}_A(T)=\operatorname{Fun}(\mathbf N_{\geq1}^{\mathrm{op}},\operatorname{Mod}(A_T))$ of [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Let $u:T'\xrightarrow{\sim}T$ be any underlying-scheme isomorphism, not assumed linear over an additional base. Use the canonical ring identifications $u^{-1}A_T\cong A_{T'}$ respecting every quotient projection and transition [lem-weil-pbc-profinite-coefficient-inverse-image]. Write $G_u$ for inverse-image reindexing on completed-ring modules and its termwise action on strict towers [lem-weil-proetale-isomorphism-inverse-image]. These are exact equivalences and induce equivalences on the unbounded derived categories, with inverse given by reverse reindexing.

For every strict tower $C_\bullet$ there is a natural isomorphism
$$G_uR\lim C_\bullet\xrightarrow{\sim}R\lim G_uC_\bullet$$
induced by inverse images of the tower projections, where $R\lim$ is the functor on the derived strict-tower category [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-strict-tower-homotopy-limit]. For every derived $I$-complete $K$ [def-weil-pbc-intrinsic-completion], this gives a canonical isomorphism
$$Lu^*_{\mathrm{comp}}K=R\lim G_uK_\bullet\xrightarrow{\sim}G_uR\lim K_\bullet\xrightarrow{\sim}G_uK.$$
Its inverse is exactly the specified ordinary-to-completed pullback map of [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback], using the quotient-tower completion unit of [prop-weil-pbc-koszul-reconstruction].

Put $Q_{T,\bullet}=((P_n)_T)_n$, $\Delta$ for the constant diagram functor, and $\mathcal R_T(F)=\Delta F\otimes^L_{\Delta A_T}Q_{T,\bullet}$ on the small ringed diagram sites used in [def-cbc-completed-exchange-map]. The specified tensor comparison
$$t_{u,F}:\mathcal R_{T'}(G_uF)\xrightarrow{\sim}G_u\mathcal R_T(F)$$
is the reindexing comparison in the derived category of actual strict towers. On flat tensor representatives it sends a relabeled $x\otimes a$ to the same $x\otimes a$, and for $P_{n+1}\to P_n$ its two transition composites send this tensor to $x\otimes\bar a$, compatibly with the completed module actions.

More generally, for a commutative scheme square $p:\overline X\to Y$, $p':\overline X'\to Y'$, $g:Y'\xrightarrow{\sim}Y$, $v:\overline X'\xrightarrow{\sim}\overline X$, with $pv=gp'$, the specified ordinary completed-ring direct-image mate and the specified diagram-site direct-image mate are respectively the reindexing comparisons $G_gRp_*\simeq Rp'_*G_v$ and $G_gRp_*^{\operatorname{Tow}}\simeq Rp'_*^{\operatorname{Tow}}G_v$, for the canonical adjunctions of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations].

proof.text: Apply lem-pur-completed-module-section-reindexing for the section-normalized ordinary module equivalence with the actual reverse pullback. Change its functor and inverse along its literal functor equalities. A generic proved helper using Mathlib Equivalence.congrRight applies it to strict diagrams. The ordinary exactness instances give finite limit and finite colimit preservation. A separate generic proved helper using Equivalence.mapDerivedCategory gives both derived equivalences, with precisely d.pull and d.towerPull and their reverse pullbacks.

Take beta and b from lem-pur-reindexing-limit-unit-normalization. For TowerComplete K the specified completionUnit(K) is invertible by definition. Compose b inverse on the strict reduction tower with the inverse of d.pull u applied to completionUnit(K). The lemma's augmentation equality identifies its inverse with ordinaryToCompleted. Cancelling the latter pulled unit proves the second normalization equation exactly. The inverse/cancellation calculation is checked generically before substituting the completed derived functors.

The defining existsUnique characterization of reductionTowerPullbackIso supplies IsCompletedReductionPullbackComparison. The existing proved pure-tensor formula levelPullIso_tensor gives the local tensor clause, and completedReductionLevelPullbackIso_transition gives every index-arrow equation. These are exactly the remaining reduction clauses, with no additional K-flat model construction required here.

A commutative square with v and g invertible is a pullback by Mathlib IsPullback.of_horiz_isIso. Choose its canonical isoPullback, retaining both projection equations. Apply lem-pur-reindexing-ordinary-mate-sections for invertibility and the section formula. Whiskering that invertible natural transformation proves the ordinary tower mate invertible. Apply lem-pur-reindexing-derived-mate-localization for both derived invertibilities and both K-injective normalization equations. Assemble the conjunctions, specializing d to pbcPadicCoefficientDatum l E.
